nodes.description: Public provenance hash string for the clown collection, set by owner via setProvenanceHash.
Block number recorded to later derive the reveal starting index; set in mintClown and emergencySetStartingIndexBlock.
Derived pseudo-random reveal offset computed from blockhash in setStartingIndex.
Constant mint price of 0.075 ETH per clown, used to validate msg.value in mintClown.
Constant cap of 20 tokens purchasable per transaction, enforced in mintClown.
Maximum supply of clowns, set in constructor and enforced across minting and index derivation.
Boolean gate controlling whether mintClown may execute; toggled by flipSaleState.
Timestamp after which the starting index block becomes eligible to be set; set in constructor and setRevealTimestamp.
Array of payout recipient addresses hardcoded at declaration, iterated in withdrawAll.
Array of payout percentages (80/15/3/2) used to split the contract balance in withdrawAll.
Constructor of Clown that sets MAX_CLOWN and REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from arguments.
onlyOwner function that loops over withdrawAddresses and sends the balance share via low-level send.
onlyOwner function that mints 20 tokens to the owner via _safeMint.
onlyOwner setter for REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
onlyOwner setter for the CLOWN_PROVENANCE hash.
onlyOwner setter for the ERC721 base URI.
onlyOwner function that toggles saleIsActive.
Payable public mint function validating sale state, purchase cap, supply cap and msg.value, then calling _safeMint in a loop.
Public function deriving the reveal starting index from blockhash of startingIndexBlock, with a fallback to the previous block hash.
onlyOwner function that sets startingIndexBlock to the current block number.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, owner check and operator reference.
Miner-influenceable timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in mintClown.
Low-level send() transfer to payable(withdrawAddresses[i]) inside withdrawAll, an external value transfer.
_safeMint external call triggering onERC721Received callback on the recipient contract.
Use of blockhash/block.number as weak pseudo-randomness source in setStartingIndex.
Acceptance and validation of msg.value against ClownPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) in mintClown.
User-supplied quantity of tokens to mint in mintClown.
New reveal timestamp argument for setRevealTimestamp.
New provenance hash argument for setProvenanceHash.
New base URI argument for setBaseURI.
Constructor argument assigning MAX_CLOWN.
Constructor argument used to derive REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Local snapshot of address(this).balance in withdrawAll.
Computed payout share per recipient in withdrawAll.
Snapshot of totalSupply() used as mint base in reserveClown.
Token id computed from totalSupply() each loop iteration in mintClown.

edges.reason: User-supplied numberOfTokens controls loop count and price validation in mintClown.
revealTimeStamp argument is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
provenanceHash argument is written into CLOWN_PROVENANCE.
baseURI argument is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
constructor argument maxNftSupply initializes MAX_CLOWN.
constructor argument saleStart derives REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
msg.sender is used as the recipient of _safeMint in mintClown.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient in reserveClown.
withdrawAll is protected by onlyOwner, which compares owner() with msg.sender.
block.timestamp is compared to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP to decide startingIndexBlock, a timestamp dependency.
REVEAL_TIMESTAMP is referenced in the mintClown reveal condition.
MAX_CLOWN bounds totalSupply() during mintClown.
ClownPrice is multiplied by numberOfTokens to validate msg.value.
saleIsActive gate determines whether mintClown body executes.
withdrawAddresses is iterated as payout recipients in withdrawAll.
withdrawPercents determines the amount sent to each recipient in withdrawAll.
contractBalance is multiplied by withdrawPercents to compute amount.
amount is the value passed to the low-level send inside withdrawAll.
constructor writes MAX_CLOWN.
constructor writes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
mintClown performs the msg.value payment validation.
mintClown calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
reserveClown calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
withdrawAll performs an external value transfer via low-level send.
setStartingIndex relies on blockhash/block.number for pseudo-randomness.
setStartingIndex computes and stores startingIndex.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock to derive the hash.
setStartingIndex takes modulo MAX_CLOWN when deriving startingIndex.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes block.number into startingIndexBlock.
flipSaleState negates and writes saleIsActive.
setRevealTimestamp writes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
setProvenanceHash writes CLOWN_PROVENANCE.
supply local variable seeds the minted token ids in reserveClown.
mintIndex local variable is the token id passed to _safeMint in mintClown.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only used within mintClown for loop count and price validation; fold into the function node.
Sole argument of setRevealTimestamp, directly assigned to REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Sole argument of setProvenanceHash, directly assigned to CLOWN_PROVENANCE.
Sole argument of setBaseURI, forwarded to _setBaseURI.
Constructor argument used only to initialize MAX_CLOWN.
Constructor argument used only to derive REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Local balance snapshot used only inside withdrawAll computation.
Local payout value used only inside withdrawAll send loop.
Local totalSupply snapshot used only inside reserveClown mint loop.
Local token id computed per iteration and used only inside mintClown.
